integrity: Symbolic and numerical checks are supplied in checker.py. Finite tests are not used as proof of existence or uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Local branch and bifurcation near the transverse one-lap orbit only; no global attractor classification or robustness to unrelated relay perturbations. The precise result has not been independently validated.
title: A sharp supercritical flip and critical relaxation in a two-threshold affine relay
